entry.title: UK armed forces step up monitoring of increased Russian activity in UK waters
entry.summary: Royal Navy warships and helicopters spent 21 days on operations monitoring Russian activity in UK waters and the North Atlantic throughout July.

entry.title: Taking medication this summer? What you need to know about sun and heat exposure
entry.summary: Some medicines can make you more sensitive to the sun or increase the risk of dehydration without you realising it. The MHRA is encouraging people to know the risks and stay protected this summer.

entry.summary: Defence Secretary on his first visit to Scotland tours Babcock’s Rosyth facility and Service Family Accommodation in Edinburgh
